svg.title: Dark Gray with White Rectangle II
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. White foreground rectangle retained; dark gray appears almost black in the source photograph. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for gray, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
